{{Top|leg}}
A '''power-flux regulator''' was a simple piece of technology that could be found in several machines, such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and vehicle ignition systems. Using a power-flux regulator in conjunction with a [[power condenser]], allowed a [[DataSearch Engine 9C]] to search systems for low-level encrypted files without destroying the information it was searching. Power-flux regulators and power condensers could not be used in conjunction with the [[DataSearch Engine 12C-A]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
